steps.label: clinic_access_lookup
steps.sub: the single source of truth for which user sees which clinic

steps.label: A SQL row filter function
steps.sub: compliance_team sees everything; everyone else checks the lookup

steps.label: ALTER TABLE ... SET ROW FILTER
steps.sub: attached to the table itself -- no query can bypass it

code:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION
  harborview.gold.clinic_row_filter(clinic_id STRING)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
RETURN
  is_account_group_member('compliance_team')
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM harborview.gold.clinic_access_lookup a
    WHERE a.user_email = current_user()
      AND a.clinic_id = clinic_row_filter.clinic_id
  );
caption: Compliance sees all 15 clinics; everyone else sees only their own.
Enforced by the catalog on every query -- dashboard, notebook, or BI tool.

subtitle: Row filters handled who sees which clinic -- next, who sees the SSN itself.
